package.description: WCAG 2.0 success criteria package for ART.
package.author: W3C

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.desc: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose.
criteria.failures: Missing alternative text for meaningful images.
criteria.fixes: Provide meaningful text alternatives using alt text or equivalent mechanism.

criteria.title: Info and Relationships
criteria.desc: Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined.
criteria.failures: Using visual formatting alone to communicate structure.
criteria.fixes: Use semantic markup such as headings, lists, and table headers.

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.desc: All functionality is operable through a keyboard interface.
criteria.failures: Interactive controls not reachable or operable with keyboard only.
criteria.fixes: Ensure controls are focusable and support expected keyboard interaction.

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.desc: Any keyboard operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible.
criteria.failures: No visual indicator for focused elements.
criteria.fixes: Provide a clear visible focus indicator for all interactive elements.
